verdict.rationale: The only rule-like evidence is HCP Terraform policy enforcement: policies are rules evaluated automatically on Terraform runs to check compliance, with results you can view and override. Separately, `-auto-approve` lets a plan apply without interactive confirmation. These are guardrails and non-interactive execution, not a general event-to-action rule engine. Missing for 10: user-defined event triggers (e.g. VCS pushes, run triggers, webhooks or notifications), configurable actions fired on events, and any hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
